subject: set value of an input from the server-side

messages.author: 4607d18cb6bf89f0
messages.subject: set value of an input from the server-side
parts:
I'm building on the implementation of the a spreadsheet-like input (you can see early trials here: https://github.com/cafe876/Shiny-Sandbox.git).

At this stage, I'm struggling with the fact that it should be both and input (you can modify the data) and an output (it is also used to display results).


Specifically, what is the way to set the value of an input from the server-side ?

Will it work with Dynamic UI, and would it then depend on the change of other inputs ?
Is there another way ?

Thanks in advance for your help !

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Re: set value of an input from the server-side
parts:
RenderUI can be used to generate UI including new (or updated) shiny inputs, and you can put any value you like as the new input.

Javascript can also be used to control UI including shiny inputs.  See my previous post on URL Hash for an example.

-Alex
